## Problem and change / 问题与修改

Describe the concrete behavior before and after this change.

## Validation / 验证

List commands run and their results. Include desktop/mobile screenshots for visual changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and relevant specs are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] Appropriate regression checks pass using synthetic/demo content.
- [ ] No credentials, private notes, drafts or private test artifacts are included.
- [ ] Third-party licenses and attribution are preserved.
